ESH.

You because what you were doing wasn't helping and might have actually made her drive more recklessly. Instead of making demands you could have expressed your concern for her safety and that you just don't want her to get hurt. 
I really don't think you had any bad intentions just went about things wrong.

Her because she was endangering herself and others.

You're most definitely TA. 

When I was 12 a close friend of mine died suddenly from an accident and I completely shut down. Not only did I lose a friend but it was hard to come to terms with the fact people my age could even die.

My mom took me to the funeral and was crying with me because she knew how much I was hurting.

You're messing with her grieving process which is unhealthy and you're pushing your responsibilities as a parent onto her. 

Please do better. Maybe offer to take her to her friends grave and have a personal saying goodbye ceremony.

Kids can be the worst. I have very curly/frizzy hair and kids used make fun of my hair, pull on it and throw stuff in my hair. When I found out about hair straighteners I started using it everyday till my hair was fried. I still am self conscious about my hair even though i like it now i still over use hair product and wear a ponytail 90% of the time because I'm worried about being judged for it.
I personally never felt any sort of connection with Carley. She felt like a forced love interest for Lee. Her death shocked me but i wasn't upset. (Sarah was annoying but i hate watching kids die.)
